verdict.rationale: Ultrametric supplies process guides and saved company context that the user's own agent reads through the CLI or MCP. It states it 'runs no model', and nothing in the evidence shows it scheduling, triggering, or running automations autonomously in the background. The `--period` option only separates saved runs of a recurring process; it is record-keeping, not a recurring schedule. Any autonomous execution would come from the host agent, which is a host-platform capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
